description: Lumped 0D oxy-fuel furnace: combustion stoichiometry in O2 + recycled flue gas, furnace energy-balance ODE with recycle ratio controlling flame temperature, dry-basis CO2 purity after water knockout.
source: Buhre et al. (2005), Prog. Energy Combust. Sci. 31(4) 283-307; Toftegaard et al. (2010), 36(5) 581-625; Turns (2012) An Introduction to Combustion.

o2_purity.note: ASU O2 purity; balance is Ar+trace N2 (Buhre 2005: 95-99.5%)

excess_o2_ratio.note: Excess O2 above stoichiometric (lambda-1); oxy-fuel runs low excess

cp_gas.note: Mean flue-gas (CO2/H2O-rich) specific heat at furnace T

cp_gas_flame.note: Effective high-T cp of CO2/H2O-rich gas near flame (rises strongly with T, with dissociation)

hA_wall_per_kgfuel.note: Lumped furnace heat-transfer coefficient*area per unit fuel rate

m_furnace_gas_per_kgfuel.note: Gas holdup in furnace per unit fuel rate (sets time constant)
